Class TuiView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.View.View
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.View.TUI.TuiView
public class TuiView extends View
Procedural TUI (no external libraries: just Scanner + ANSI).

Threading Model

Two threads:
  • main (UI thread) — executes run(), prints screens and reads from stdin. Waits for its turn by polling lightly on gameView.
  • update-dispatcher — daemon launched once, reads the messages queue (populated by the network pump of ClientController) and applies updates to gameView without touching stdin. Prints errors to screen, ignores informative notifications (phase/turn).

Input

Everything via numbers + ENTER; 0 is always "back / skip". The Scanner is used defensively (readInt, readLine) to tolerate malformed input.

Windows Notes

We do not manage clear-screen or raw-mode: every redraw is an append to stdout, compatible with cmd.exe without VT. ANSI escapes are used only for colors: on terminals that don't support them they appear as noisy sequences but the TUI remains playable.
